newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stock index sets record in mixed market.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stock index sets record in mixed market.

text.p: * Toronto 300 index climbed to record close on Tuesday, but the broader market ended mixed * 9 of 14 sectors higher, gains offset by weak golds, conglomerates * 90 million shares traded.
The Toronto Stock Exchange's key index set another record close on Tuesday, extending Monday's gains despite a sluggish session.
The TSE 300 Composite Index climbed 8.86 points to 6801.17, its 29th record finish of the year.
But the overall market was mixed. Declining stocks outnumbered advances 511 to 484, with 293 issues unchanged.
Strength in energy, real estate, retailing and forestry products was partly offset by profit-taking in conglomerates and precious metals.
